liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Queen Jane Approximately** (3 other sources): Jerry started Peggy-O both before and after Queen Jane Approximately; Jerry began Peggy-O before and again after Queen Jane Approximately [2][3][5]
- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Reviewer was struck by the Aiko Aiko, Dark Star, Terrapin Station sequence; Hornsby played accordion during Dark Star, which this listener strongly disliked [20][21][26]
- **Iko Iko** (2 reviews): Accordion adds a Cajun flavor to Iko Iko and pushes the jam to its peaks; Jerry began Iko Iko in the wrong key, stopped, composed himself, and restarted with correct chords [24][30]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat into Rider opened the second set with great energy [20]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Stella Blue is solid and worth hearing [23]

## The recordings

- **gd90-12-12.sbd.zei.2030.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 184 min; rated 4.31/5 by 35 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears Vince's keyboard sound as pitched toward the upper midrange [21]
- **gd1990-12-12.149736.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 187 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1990-12-12.mtx.tobin.87659.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 185 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1990-12-12.149544.ultramatrix.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 22 songs; 187 min [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls leaving a show in Rocky Mountain rain over dusted streets, with Shakedown going on; unsure which night [23]
- Reviewer saw this Colorado run while working as a ski bum, calling it the year's highlight [25]
- Reviewer, a 19-year-old living in Boulder, had backstage passes for this Denver run [27]
- The audience tape captures a memorable moment of cool Colorado rain [31]
- Vocals on this run of shows were more polished than the reviewer was used to [21]
- Reviewer ranks this second set among the best of 1990, possibly the best [24]
- Reviewer found the second set the best stretch of Dead music in years [25]
- A 9-28-90 rehearsal with the Dead and Hornsby has run-throughs of Saint, Stander, and Valley Road [29]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-12-12.sbd.zei.2030.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> D-> CDR-> EAC> SHN [1]. Also: Reviewer owns an audience recording made by a taper from Albuquerque, NM, and prefers it to the soundboard; Soundboard to DAT to CDR, extracted with EAC to SHN; ripped by John Zei [1][31]
- **gd1990-12-12.149736.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  April 14, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several sets of masters were combined to complete the show [2]
- **gd1990-12-12.mtx.tobin.87659.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 3 Source Mix (60%-SBD/40%-AUD) [3]. Also: Healy DAT from Todd Evans's collection, transferred via TASCAM DA-20 and Lynx interface into Wavelab; Mastered by Charlie Miller; edited by Jamie Waddell on the GEMS Edit Station, September 2007 [3]
- **gd1990-12-12.149544.ultramatrix.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [5]
